provenance: Separate-agent adversarial review in the same model/team lineage. Not independent external review.
review_kind: raw proof derivation, quantifier, semantic dictionary and vacuity audit

validation.scope: Fresh file acceptance only; integrated axiom audit and kernel replay remain parent responsibilities.

claim: Splitting one parent prior mass among mixture children preserves normalized prior, evidence, posterior child total and every other posterior; joint-event mixture consistency preserves each predictive event.
assumptions: Nonnegative priors and likelihoods; summable weights, priors and unnormalized evidence.
Child weights sum to one; original prior normalized.
Whole-record parent likelihood is the weighted child likelihood sum.
Original evidence is strictly positive; predictive event comparison additionally assumes the corresponding joint-likelihood mixture.
dependency_graph: Factor parent prior out of the summable child evidence sum.
Replace the child evidence sum by the original parent contribution.
The original and refined positive normalizers coincide.
Divide summed child and other evidence by the common normalizer; apply the same argument to joint evidence.

obligation_matrix.obligation: RefinementContract prevents zero-normalizer and nonsummable-evidence vacuity.
Parent-prior zero, empty other-family, and singleton child-family remain valid.
The fixed-child whole-record assumption is explicit and distinct from stepwise switching.
Predictive_event_unchanged is universally quantified over scalar joint-event inputs; applying it eventwise gives the distribution assertion when inputs are actual joint likelihoods.

residual_limits: The theorem does not construct a predictive kernel or justify arbitrary numbers as joint likelihoods.
No claim that independently averaged one-step mixtures preserve a fixed-child mechanism.
strongest_safe_statement: Splitting one parent prior mass among mixture children preserves normalized prior, evidence, posterior child total and every other posterior; joint-event mixture consistency preserves each predictive event.
cheapest_next_check: Parent integrated clean compile, exhaustive axiom audit and kernel replay against the same source hashes.
